raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":1996,"db":"MYSQL","query":"SELECT '2024' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit FROM education_2024.course UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit FROM education_2025.course;"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的平均学分，取课程表学分，返回两年平均学分，对课程求平均","tables":["MYSQL:education_2024.course","MYSQL:education_2025.course"],"columns":["credit"]}],"assumptions":["问题中的“学期一”理解为2024学年和2025学年，分别对应education_2024和education_2025数据库中的课程表","“对课程求平均”理解为对课程表中的学分字段求平均值"]}
